data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nur' meaning 'light' and 'ahan' meaning 'the eyes'. The name Nurahan symbolizes being a source of light and guidance, illuminating the path for others. The name Nurahan carries the meaning “Light of the eyes” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nurahan usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the eyes and live with faith, good character and purpose.
